sentences.en: Sticking up philosophical words together won't make you more of an intellectual.
sentences.zh: 1. 把哲学词汇拼凑在一起并不能让你变得更博学。

sentences.en: Poetry is deeper and more philosophical than history.
sentences.zh: 2. 诗歌比历史更深刻、更具哲理性。

sentences.en: Fanaticism is a monster a thousand times more dangerous than philosophical atheism.
sentences.zh: 3. 狂热是比哲学无神论危险一千倍的怪物。

phrases.zh: 1. 对...持达观态度；对...保持冷静

senses.zh: 哲学上的，哲学（家）的,冷静的，沉着的,明达的,达观的
